title: In Japan, sees himself reported killed in action
description: While in Japan around August 1965, Larry personally saw a notice or article in the military newspaper Stars and Stripes reporting that he had been killed in action. The report was wrong. Finding the original item, any correction, and the documentation explaining the error is one of the most important research goals of this project.
larrysRecollection: Around August 1965, Larry was in Japan. He personally remembers seeing a notice or article saying he had been killed.
researchNotes: Search contemporary Stars and Stripes issues (Pacific edition), Army casualty documentation, morning reports, and personnel records; look for an incident involving someone with a similar name. Captain "Guegler" may be associated with this event or period. The story is preserved exactly as Larry tells it and is not treated as confirmed until documentary evidence is found.
